examples.text: Die Geraden g und f sind zueinander orthogonal.

examples.text: Die Geraden g und f sind zueinander orthogonal.

glosses: Of two objects, at right angles; perpendicular to each other.

examples.text: A chord and the radius that bisects it are orthogonal.

glosses: Of a pair of vectors: having a zero inner product; perpendicular.

examples.text: The normal vector and tangent vector at a given point are orthogonal.

glosses: Of a square matrix: such that its transpose is equal to its inverse.
Of a linear transformation: preserving its angles.
Of grid graphs, board games and polyominoes: vertical or horizontal but not diagonal.
Of a pair of elements in an ortholattice: each less than or equal to the orthocomplement of the other.
Statistically independent, with reference to variates.
Of two or more aspects of a problem, able to be treated separately; of a design, exhibiting consistency and composability.

examples.text: The content of the message should be orthogonal to the means of its delivery.

An orthogonal approach also promotes reuse. If components have specific, well-defined responsibilities, they can be combined with new components in ways that were not envisioned by their original implementors.

glosses: Of two or more problems or subjects, independent of or irrelevant to each other.

examples.text: Even in a geostate, some people are willing to fight and die for their views, but the institutional change to a polystate seems somewhat orthogonal to such issues.

glosses: An orthogonal line.

examples.text: All of the orthogonals in this painting display an understanding of linear perspective.
